item.name: 4. First Home Loan: single applicant over the $95k cap -> no FHL scenario, flag fhl_income_over_cap
5. User-supplied interest rate and chat-supplied build year/cladding (leaky-building items)
6. "Not found is not no risk": primary hazard layers unavailable -> warnings hazards_partial / hazards_unavailable
7. CV missing -> use price_override
8. Cash purchase (deposit equals price) -> warning cash_purchase_no_loan
9. Validation error (negative deposit) -> 422 {"error": {...}}
10. Wrong method -> 405 method_not_allowed
